semiconductor_relevance: High — Toyoko Gas Equipments provides essential industrial gases and equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Toyoko Gas Equipments (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying industrial gases and related equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include specialty gases like high-purity helium and nitric oxide, as well as comprehensive support services such as on-site management and maintenance for gas systems.
capabilities: On-site gas system management and maintenance

regional_presence.China: Established in 2002 in Shanghai's Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone, serving numerous well-known enterprises in the semiconductor sector.
